cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.

mechanism: A directs dinner service and shares its work so B can treat a talking cupboard as an ordinary guest.
confusable: Unlike only accepting a strange fact, A recruits B into specific normal hosting behavior adapted to the guest.
comparison: Cupboard table service differs from introductions and seating for an invisible guest.
seedUse: D145-a napkin, handle and soup; S02-a adapts hosting directions to B practical objection.
